# Project instructions

<!-- ===== WORKFLOW BLOCK — do not edit; merge, never overwrite project instructions ===== -->

This project runs under a defined development workflow.

**Before doing anything else, read `.workflow/bootstrap.md`**, and `.workflow/config.md` for this project's settings. `config.md` names where this project's workflow state lives — task folders, `TASKS.md`, `decisions.md`. **That state is outside the repo; never create task files inside the repo.**

Do not start work until Luka gives a gate from the table in `.workflow/bootstrap.md` (`init`, `sealed 03`, `continue 03`, `apply 03` …) or `DIRECT <description>`. A gate without a task id, other than `init`, is ambiguous — ask. In the sealed stage, never open the other model's pass file.

Never write in any `luka.md`. Talk to Luka in Serbian. Code and comments in English.
